d: We’re hiring an account manager to run their own book of the founders we work with, and to be the person each of them works with every week.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

You run the founder side of Pairs for your book. Every founder gets a call with you each week, you go through their investor meetings with them and what to change before the next one, and between calls you are the one they write to. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to your founders.
q: Communicate clearly and with confidence, on calls and in writing.
Know how a seed to Series B round works, because you raised one yourself or worked at a fund or an accelerator.
Can walk us through a renewal or an upgrade you sold yourself.
Build trust by listening first and respecting a founder’s time.
Handle confidential deal and investor information with care.
r: Your book of founders, from their first week with Pairs to their renewal.
A strategy call with every founder in your book each week, prepared before it starts and followed up the same day.
An answer to every question between calls, on the same day.
Renewals and upgrades in your book. We measure you on how many of your founders stay and how many take a longer plan.
What you hear from founders, passed to our investor team so the next meetings we book fit better.
x: OTE of $100,000 to $160,000 USD, base plus commission.

Fully remote. Your founders are in the US, so your calls sit in US Eastern hours. The team works across London, New York, Dubai and San Francisco. You get the best AI tools, paid for, a written playbook for your calls and a senior team that coaches you every week.
Apply through our short form. Tell us about the book of clients you ran and what you did when one of them wanted to leave. Describe your clients by type and leave their names out.
